**CustomAchievements 1.9.0** — for Paper 1.21.4 (Java 21). Drop the jar into
your server's `plugins/` folder. New config options are merged into your
existing `config.yml` automatically on first startup.

### Added
- **Material groups for block and item objectives.** An objective can now target
  a whole family of materials instead of a single one, so **"mine 100 logs"** is
  one objective covering every wood type — no more settling for "100 oak logs".

  The target picker lists the groups first, each showing how many materials it
  covers: **Any Logs**, **Any Ores**, **Any Planks**, **Any Leaves**, **Any
  Saplings**, **Any Flowers**, **Any Crops**, **Stone Types**, **Dirt & Grass**,
  **Sand & Gravel**, **Wool**, **Terracotta**, **Concrete**, **Glass**,
  **Coral**, **Ice**, **Mushrooms**, **Slabs**, **Stairs**, **Fences** and
  **Doors**.

  In `achievements.yml` a group is written with a leading `#`, mirroring
  Minecraft's own tag syntax:

  ```yaml
  target: '#LOGS'
  amount: 100
  ```

  Groups work with `BLOCK_BREAK`, `BLOCK_PLACE`, `ITEM_CRAFT`, `ITEM_CONSUME` and
  `ITEM_OBTAIN`. Membership is worked out from material names on the running
  server, so wood and ore types added by future Minecraft versions are picked up
  automatically. Existing objectives that name a single material are unaffected.
